summary: Persist the Human-selected Planning-Integrity Thin Correction as the only active bounded Work Package, bind it to Planning Owner #7 through a small versioned planning projection, and preserve fresh derivation after closure.

requirements.rationale: The correction changes planning projection and active-work selection only; no Requirement semantics are changed.

issues_findings.rationale: #73 is the single Human-selected bounded Work Package. #7 remains Planning Owner. PR #72 remains recovery/candidate evidence and does not become current-state authority.

risks.rationale: Continuity, drift, authority, accretion and false-assurance risks remain applicable. The bounded projection is deliberately rejected if it becomes a second mutable planning clock or speculative roadmap.

decisions_concepts.rationale: Human priority authority selected Planning-Integrity Thin Correction first. The technical representation remains deliberately thin: a versioned selection projection bound to existing #7 and the execution cursor, not a new Planning Owner, registry, planner or roadmap.

derived_views.rationale: CURRENT_STATE is regenerated only to bind its reconciliation provenance to this material activation; planning truth remains in the Planning Owner, versioned projection and execution cursor.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: The prior not-derived state is resolved by explicit Human priority selection. #73 is now the only active bounded Work Package; implementation is allowed within its reversible bounded scope and merge remains unauthorized.

active_work.rationale: Exactly one bounded Work Package is active. All other open Issues/PRs remain unselected unless separately activated by material authority. Closure of #73 requires fresh derivation and does not imply a downstream priority.
